policies.title: Bhutanese ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service accepts citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Use a Bhutanese ordinary passport issued through the Royal Government's Passport Office. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days.
Apply online, upload documents and pay. The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. Its current document does not identify a Bhutanese ordinary-passport waiver; the all-country eVisa route is retained with medium confidence.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the Bhutanese ordinary passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present it for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Bhutanese ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
conditions: Use the Bhutanese ordinary passport used for travel; the live service excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not a visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register using the Bhutanese ordinary passport for travel.
Pay and receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
Carry the issued record for final immigration processing.
